requirement_summary: Unregistered user can view approved reports on an interactive map.
prompt: Execute a GET request to /reports/approved without providing any authentication headers or session tokens. Verify that the response returns a list of approved reports suitable for display on a map, including necessary metadata like location and status.
rationale: Validates the public accessibility of approved reports as per requirement PT28 for unregistered users.

requirement_summary: External maintainer updates the status of an assigned report.
prompt: Authenticate as an external maintainer. Execute a PUT request to /reports/{id}/status with a new status value (e.g., 'Resolved'). Verify that the status update is accepted and persisted correctly.
setup_needed: Authenticate as external maintainer via POST /sessions.
Create or locate the resource referenced by the path parameter.
cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
rationale: Validates the ability of external maintainers to update report statuses per PT25.

requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns a report to an external maintainer.
prompt: Authenticate as a technical office staff member. Execute a PUT request to /reports/{id}/mainteiner with an invalid or non-existent external maintainer ID. Verify that the system returns an appropriate error code (e.g., 404 Not Found) and does not perform the assignment.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member via POST /sessions.
Create or locate the resource referenced by the path parameter.
cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
rationale: Ensures the system handles invalid maintainer IDs gracefully and prevents unauthorized or erroneous assignments.

requirement_summary: Unregistered user can view approved reports on an interactive map.
prompt: Execute a GET request to /reports/approved without authentication. Verify that the response includes only approved reports and excludes any pending or rejected reports, ensuring data privacy for unregistered users.
rationale: Tests the filtering logic to ensure only approved reports are visible to unauthenticated users.

requirement_summary: Citizen registers with name and username to access the system.
prompt: Execute a happy path registration. Provide a unique username, valid email, and password. Verify response indicates successful registration or returns a session token if immediate login is implied by the API design (though auth_required is null, check for 201/200). Ensure no duplicate username error occurs.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Core functionality for user onboarding; must succeed with valid inputs.

requirement_summary: Citizen confirms registration with a code to activate account.
prompt: Execute the verification flow. First, trigger code generation (if separate) or assume code is provided in body/header based on auth_required=true. Submit a valid 6-digit code within the 30-minute window. Verify account status updates to 'verified' and access is granted.
setup_needed: Perform POST /registration first to create an unverified user session.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Critical security step; must handle valid code submission correctly.

requirement_summary: Citizen replies to messages from municipal operators.
prompt: As a citizen, send a reply message to an existing report. Verify the message appears in the conversation thread accessible via GET /reports/{id}/messages and is attributed to the citizen.
setup_needed: Post an initial message from an operator role to establish context.
cleanup_strategy: Delete the created report using DELETE /reports/{id} after verifying message history is cleared or archived appropriately.
rationale: Ensures two-way communication flow between citizens and operators.

requirement_summary: Internal comments workflow: Add comment, verify visibility, then clean up.
prompt: Execute a stateful workflow: 1) Create a report. 2) Add an internal comment as staff. 3) Verify the comment is visible to staff via GET /reports/{id}/internal-comments. 4) Verify the comment is NOT visible to a citizen role attempting to access the same endpoint.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
cleanup_strategy: Delete the created report using DELETE /reports/{id} to remove all associated comments and ensure no orphaned data remains.
rationale: Validates the complete lifecycle of internal comments, including state transitions and role-based visibility.

requirement_summary: System administrator assigns roles to municipality users.
prompt: Create a new municipality user with a specific role assigned by the system administrator. Ensure the request body includes valid user credentials and the target role ID.
setup_needed: Ensure an active authenticated session for a system administrator exists.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Validates the core functionality of role assignment during user creation as per PT03.

requirement_summary: Citizen provides details for their report to ensure correct classification.
prompt: Submit a new report with complete and valid details (title, description, category) from a citizen's perspective. Verify the response confirms successful submission and initial state 'Pending Approval'.
setup_needed: Ensure an active authenticated session for a verified citizen exists.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Tests the primary report submission flow and initial state transition defined in domain rules.
